query: Will my CPF Investment Scheme (CPFIS) investments be sold or liquidated when I apply to withdraw my CPFIS investments upon meeting CPF withdrawal conditions?
reference_answer: Applying to withdraw your CPFIS investments will not result in liquidation of your investment holdings. If your withdrawal application is approved, your agent bank and/or product providers will contact you on the transfer of your investments to you.

Cash top-ups are not allowed, except in the case of taking up entitlements (e.g. rights shares) or conversion of entitlements. You may top-up your CPF Investment Account through your agent bank if you have insufficient CPF savings or stock limit to subscribe for the entitlements or conversion. However, such cash top-ups are not withdrawable or refundable, even if your applications are unsuccessful.

If this happens, you have to exercise the switching option within the timeframe stipulated by the Fund Management Company/insurer in its communication letter to you.

If your stockbrokers use the outdated investment account number, your CPF trades will fail and you will need to settle your trades using cash.
answer: No, your CPFIS investments won't be sold or liquidated when you apply to withdraw them. Instead, they'll be transferred to your CPF account. [Document 1]
